title: The Routing Chapter Closed: A Preregistered 10-Rail Intelligent-Routing Crossfire (IR-2) — Predicted vs Observed Finality Across Bitcoin, XRP, Stellar, Cardano, Ethereum, Algorand, Avalanche, Solana, Dogecoin, and Polkadot
description:

The routing chapter of the multi-rail evidence anchoring program, closed at its target altitude. One 32-byte SHA-256 digest (SQUIRL-IP-011, "Caging the Large Language Model" — the provisional patent draft describing the deterministic cage) was inscribed across all ten certified mainnet rails in a single preregistered crossfire: Bitcoin, XRP Ledger, Stellar, Cardano, Ethereum, Algorand, Avalanche, Solana, Dogecoin, and Polkadot — each leg fired latency-ranked by the IR-1 deterministic routing engine, each carrying the 37-byte envelope SQDR+0x04+digest, each verified byte-exact by keyless public readers.

The prediction receipt: six of ten rails landed within 1.3 seconds of the preregistered prediction (Solana, Algorand, Polkadot dead-on; Stellar +0.1s; Avalanche +1.1s; XRP +1.3s); the only >3s deviations belong to the two mempool-priced rails (Ethereum, Bitcoin) — exactly the variance class the router's cost model assigns to market-priced rails. The prediction was not only accurate, its error structure was predicted. Fees for the entire ten-mainnet crossfire, failed attempts included: under $1.

Honesty spine, disclosed in full: preregistration frozen pre-broadcast (sha 171f0c57); scope stamp before first fire; all failed attempts disclosed forward-only (two Solana memo rejections, four XRPL library-shape failures, three Cardano pre-acceptance rejections, one Dogecoin query error — none hiding state changes); prereg basis was nine rails, the same-day Polkadot and Dogecoin certifications raised the fire to ten legs, disclosed as beneficial variance. Five deterministic gates PASS, no LLM in any decision path. Bundle: final report, prereg, runlog, machine-readable receipts. Program ledger (append-only) at github.com/LLong2026/four-horsemen. Dual Mesh Benchmark: MEASURED (scoped) — DeepSeek column DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345241; program benchmark DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23321637; no neural-mesh inference in any ceremony decision path. Scope caveats (load-bearing): anchoring proves existence, not authority; PQC authority split retained; reference-chain signatures are not post-quantum.
